content.text:
**Answer: 3^71 ≈ 7.5095 × 10^33**

The Wolfram|Alpha page didn't give me the result. The start URL loaded, but queries for `3^71`, "3 to the power of 71", and the natural-language form returned no computed pod. Later the page rendered as blank. I didn't try other Wolfram pages.

I got the value by hand. A log10 estimate gave 7.509467 × 10^33. The exact value I recall, 3^70 = 2503155504993241601315571986085849, times 3 gives 7509466514979724803946715958257547, which is 7.5094665 × 10^33. Both round to 7.5095 × 10^33 at five significant figures.

I couldn't run a script to double-check because Bash was denied in this session.
